title: Other Animals
scope: Strict accepted species below the exact COL26.8 Animalia kingdom root that are not claimed by a more specific static-package route.
scopeZh: 固定 COL26.8 中精确动物界根节点下，且未被更具体静态内容包路由接收的严格接受种。
disclaimer: “Other” is the deterministic remainder of this release and combines many unrelated animal phyla; it is not a taxonomic clade.
disclaimerZh: “其他”是该版本的确定性余集，合并了多个无直接亲缘关系的动物门，并非分类学演化支。
evidenceBoundary: This package preserves official COL26.8 nomenclatural and placement fields only; it does not assert an Evo Atlas dossier, biological evidence, media, fossils, ecology, translation, or expert review.

scope.packageOwnership: other-animals is the deterministic COL26.8 residual route below Animalia (N); Platyhelminthes 7NF2H has no more-specific static-package route.
scope.nonApplicableBoundary: All other-animals strict accepted species not descending from 7NF2H are non-applicable to this Platyhelminthes sidecar. They remain in the mixed resource pack and are not silently mapped to ITIS Platyhelminthes.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Platyhelminthes species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Platyhelminthes species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Platyhelminthes species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Platyhelminthes species.

matching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact nomenclatural crosswalk for the COL26.8 Platyhelminthes partition. It is not a final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier, fossil record or scientific-review record. The other-animals resource pack is mixed; its non-Platyhelminthes remainder is explicitly out of scope.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车是 COL26.8 扁形动物分区的冻结严格命名交叉映射；它不是最终分类权威、系统发育树、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案、化石记录或科学审查记录。other-animals 资源包是混合包，其余非扁形动物物种被明确排除在本侧车之外。
